hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/packages/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/crates/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/capabilities/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/*) case "$f" in */agent-docs/*) exit 0;; esac; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Reminder (chain-sdk convention): if this change adds or materially changes a feature, add or update its agent-docs/<feature-name>/README.md (How it works / How to use it / Files to check) before finishing — see AGENTS.md > Feature docs."}}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
